name: seamless-compaction
description: Cleans old tool results out of the context when the engine compacts, with no model call and no wait. Logs every operation.

startAt.title: Start at context %
startAt.description: Clean only once the main context is at least this full, measured against the window the engine compacts at (smaller than the model's when CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW is set). Applies to the engine's own compaction in the main session. A subagent's compaction is not gated. 0 cleans on every engine compaction.

keepTurns.title: Protected prompts
keepTurns.description: The last N user prompts, and everything after them, are never touched.

minAutoPct.title: Engine compaction: minimum cleanup %
minAutoPct.description: When the engine itself starts a compaction (window full), use the cleanup if it frees at least this much. Otherwise the engine summarizes the cleaned messages.

trimChars.title: Trim results over (chars)
trimChars.description: Tool results longer than this keep their first 40 and last 20 lines. Lower it (3000 works well) when long sessions are mostly subagent reports and briefs.

subagentReports.title: Shorten old subagent reports
subagentReports.description: Outside the protected prompts, a finished subagent's report keeps its frame and first lines; the rest is cut. Only the engine's exact report frame is matched, so a prompt that quotes a report stays a prompt. Reports never count as prompts, whatever this is set to.

reportKeepLines.title: Report lines kept
reportKeepLines.description: How many non-empty lines of an old subagent report are kept. Reports put the verdict first.

writeContent.title: Drop old Write content
writeContent.description: Outside the protected prompts, an old Write call keeps its file path; content over 1500 chars becomes a pointer to the file, which is on disk.
